name: AIdol: Artificial Intelligence Idol
source:
Idols are the most popular thing in the media and the rising idol production company Lyriq has a convention to run this weekend. There is only one catch: the virtual idol named Aiko is malfunctioning. Only one thing can fix Aiko, and that is finding the person who programmed her. But it isn’t easy for a sapient computer program to find her creator–that is, without help. That’s where superfan Hana and a ragtag team of convention attendees come in to save the day.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelpineberry/aidol-artificial-intelligence-idol-a-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
偶像是媒體中最熱門的話題，新興偶像製作公司Lyriq本週末將舉辦一場展會。但有一個問題：名叫Aiko的虛擬偶像發生了故障。修好她只有一個辦法，那就是找到當初寫下她的程式設計師。然而，一個擁有自我意識的電腦程式，想靠自己找到創造者並不容易。於是，狂熱粉絲Hana與一群臨時湊在一起的參展者挺身而出，準備挽救局面。

[來源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelpineberry/aidol-artificial-intelligence-idol-a-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
